jobs.title: Research Assistant for Climate Action
jobs.description: The Research Specialist for Climate Action (RS-CA) will work with the Climate and Disaster Resilience Program of AIS through priority projects expressed in the nascent Climate Action Plan (CAP). These include a green space management tool for the University’s vegetation, and a disaster literacy index under development. Additionally, the RS-CA will also perform duties related to the climate action and disaster resilience in the University. The RS-CA reports to the Program Head for Climate and Disaster Resilience. The Research Specialist for Climate Action: facilitates focus group discussions and deploy survey questionnaire to an extensive sample size from various units of the University; conducts data gathering (e.g., surveys, FGDs) and analysis, using the necessary statistical tools, codes, and softwares; conducts, builds on, and synthesizes research on green spaces in the University, by reviewing policies and documents on their proper use, carbon sequestration potential, and biodiversity support potential develops appropriate tools on green space management in the University towards climate resilience and biodiversity support, accounting for its different typologies; writes reports and creates the accompanying presentations related to the research projects of the Climate and Disaster Resilience program, which include the study on disaster literacy index for the University and the green space management; provides supports to major office events, such as conferences; performs all other duties as may be reasonably required of the position, in accordance with the instructions of the Immediate Supervisor, and their duly authorized representative.

jobs.description: About FirstWork FirstWork is an applied AI company building the next generation of workforce operations technology. We work with companies across staffing, logistics, healthcare, and retail that manage large frontline workforces. These businesses deal with complex, highly manual processes involving hiring, onboarding, document verification, compliance, training, and ongoing workforce management. We're using AI agents to automate these workflows, working alongside human teams and integrating with the systems businesses already use. Having raised $15M in our Series A , led by Earlybird Venture Capital, bringing our total funding to $20M, we're entering an exciting phase of growth. With established enterprise customers and a growing product footprint, we're expanding beyond hiring and onboarding to build a comprehensive AI-powered workforce operations platform. About the Role We're looking for a Content & Community Manager to lead Firstwork's content engine and build our community across the UK and Europe. In this role, you'll set the editorial direction for everything Firstwork publishes, write the pieces that matter most yourself, and run our UK and European events and community. You'll work closely with our Founding Marketing Lead, who is also UK-based, as well as our global go-to-market team. jobs.description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program.
